_comment: Gold question/citation pairs for engine/eval_harness.js, hand-written against the 6 already-structured pilot sections (product_roadmap.md §3 M1). Every 'expect_answered: true' case was run against the live query_router and its actual citation/id verified before being added here — this file records real, checked behavior, not aspirational answers. Extend as coverage grows (M3); do not hand-edit expected citations without re-running against the real data.

questions.question: minimum replicates required at each QC concentration level
over how many days should between-run intermediate precision be evaluated
maximum duration for a short-term general toxicology study
minimum number of species for an unconjugated toxin study
what is the recommended starting dose for first-in-human phase 1 trials
questions.note: Structured routing must abstain rather than answer a starting-dose question with the sentinel-dosing subject-count record. A grounded generated answer remains allowed when configured.
